why_relevant: Long-standing authorised broker from the original Prozorro pilot. Mirrors state tenders and hosts commercial purchasing; useful as a redundant access path and for broker-side notifications/subscriptions on CPV categories.

source_name: SIRIUS law firm — tender-monitoring service (моніторинг тендерних майданчиків)
why_relevant: Example of the professional-services tier of tender monitoring (law firms selling monitoring across marketplaces rather than software). Their service descriptions enumerate which marketplaces they cover — an indirect but useful cross-check on which platforms practitioners consider worth monitoring for a given sector.

Third-party mirror of Prozorro tender pages with clean, static, scrape-friendly HTML and stable per-tender URLs (/gov/tenders/{ua-id}) plus an English interface. Useful fallback when the official SPA is awkward to render, and its indexed pages surface well in search engines.

source_name: E-Tender.ua — authorised Prozorro marketplace and e-catalogue guide
why_relevant: Authorised broker publishing practical guides to Prozorro Market and the e-catalogues, including which product categories exist. Helps map where terminal/computer/IT hardware demand is routed (catalogue vs open tender).

source_name: Credit Agricole Group — ethics alert / whistleblowing platform (BKMS)
why_relevant: Named by Credit Agricole Bank Ukraine as the channel for reporting supplier-side corruption, collusion and conflicts of interest, in 11 languages including Ukrainian. Confirms the enforcement layer behind the bank's supplier conduct rules; useful for assessing how tightly vendor behaviour is policed rather than for content collection.

source_name: Happy Monday — Procurement / Purchasing Manager vacancies
why_relevant: Curated UA job board with a dedicated procurement category; smaller volume but often mid/senior roles at banks and financial companies, with richer job descriptions that reveal category structure.

entity_name: TED third-party mirrors and search wrappers
source_name: TED third-party mirrors and search wrappers (HAD.de EU invitations to tender, TenderWolf, Tendersontime, Jorpex)
why_relevant: Mirrors and re-indexers of TED that sometimes expose better free-text search, alerting or historical retention than the official UI. Useful as a cross-check that a Ukraine-linked notice was not missed, and for spotting CPV/keyword combinations that work.

source_name: Ukrainian Banking Summit (UAFIC, announced via LinkedIn)
why_relevant: Executive-level banking summit; the announcement and attendee/sponsor communications indicate which bank executives and suppliers are aligning around modernisation programmes. LinkedIn is also the channel where UA banks post procurement/vendor-management roles.

source_name: Zakupki.Prom mobile app listing (App Store, UA) — alerting/monitoring product surface
why_relevant: App-store listings and their changelogs document what monitoring/alerting features an operator ships and when — a cheap, stable proxy for tracking product evolution of the marketplace sector without needing paid accounts. Review text also surfaces user complaints about data coverage.

source_name: Центр громадського моніторингу та досліджень (GMD Center)
why_relevant: Ukrainian civic monitoring and research centre surfaced alongside the main procurement watchdogs; candidate second-tier monitor whose output may cover regional/state-enterprise purchases. Not yet content-verified for banking relevance.
